thread:
julia: Hi team - POC ask from AcmeHealth. They want a short dedicated GPU pool to validate latency & cost for their clinical summary product. Need access (API + IP allowlist) and rough pricing. Target region: us-east-1. Preferred SKUs: H100 but open to alternatives. Required: ~10 concurrent sessions, avg seq 2k tokens, target p99 latency <250ms. POC window: 4 weeks starting ~2024-05-02. Can you advise availability + lead time?

omar: Thanks Julia. Quick Qs: which model family (size/quant) and is KV cache/persistent state required across requests? H100 scarce in us-east-1 right now. We can propose either 2x H100 (if we reserve early) or 3x A100-80GB as a fallback. Need confirmation on concurrency vs. throughput (tokens/sec per session).

linda: From SE side: Acme will likely run redwood-70b-8k quantized to 4-bit for this POC. They plan to reuse KV cache within a session but not persist across restarts. No heavy streaming, mostly generate short summaries (~200-500 tokens output).

chris: Noted. Also confirm whether this is a paid reserved POC (reserved pricing) or free trial. Procurement contact: procurement@acmehealth.com. They asked if we can provide a purchase order for an initial month.

sean: Back-of-envelope monthly cost estimates (inclusive of infra + reserved pool premium):
- 2x H100 (us-east-1): ~$68k/month
- 3x A100-80GB (us-east-1): ~$42k/month
These are ballpark; final quote depends on exact concurrency and token profile.

omar: infra check: quota/stock bot ran: infra-bot: "region us-east-1: H100 available nodes: 0 (on-hand), procurement ETA 4-6 weeks; A100-80GB available nodes: 6". So immediate option is A100. Lead time: we can spin up A100 pool in ~3 business days if we have VPC peering details and IP allowlist. H100 would need procurement escalations.

julia: Can we do a hybrid for the POC? Start with 3x A100-80GB for the first 2 weeks, then swap to 2x H100 if/when available? Need to avoid long downtime during swap. Also we need dedicated API key scoped to the AcmeHealth org only.

linda: Hybrid sounds fine. We should plan a canary swap with traffic cutover and fallback route back to A100 if issues. Also request 1 ephemeral S3 mount (5GB) for model artifacts.

omar: Action items for infra from this thread: 1) Provision 3x A100-80GB dedicated pool in us-east-1 (POC tag: acmehealth-poc) 2) Create org-scoped API key and IP allowlist rule for AcmeHealth bastion IPs 3) Prepare runbook for swap to H100 if/when available 4) Estimate cost uplift for swap. ETA: 3 business days for initial A100 pool.

chris: I'll tell procurement and confirm whether they'll sign a 1-month reserved PO or prefer usage billing. Julia - want me to draft the PO?

julia: Yes please, Chris. Also include network contact: netops@acmehealth.com for peering.

sean: For the quote I'll prepare two line items (A100 monthly + H100 swap option). Will attach to the PO draft.

infra-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2024-7893 - "acmehealth-poc: provision 3x A100-80GB in us-east-1, create org-scoped API key, add IP allowlist". SLA target: 72 hours.

omar: I'll pick this up tomorrow morning. Julia, please upload the procurement contact + netops IPs to the ticket and paste the model config if you have it.

julia: Uploaded PO contact and netops IPs to ticket. Also pasting desired model params here:
```
model: redwood-70b-8k-4bit
max_input_tokens: 4096
max_output_tokens: 512
concurrency_target: 10
session_kv_reuse: true
```

linda: Great. I'll schedule the canary swap playbook with infra once the A100 pool is live.

omar: Confirmed. If Acme insists on H100 we can start procurement but POC timeline will slip. Proceeding with A100 provisioning as primary.

julia: Thanks all :thumbsup: Will update the customer that pool provisioning + API key ETA ~72 hrs.

sean: Adding note: billing needs org legal name and billing address to convert to reserved billing. Julia, can you confirm?

julia: I'll get that from procurement now.

chris: 👍 looping in account manager for contract steps.

linda: tagging for follow-ups: @omar @sean once pool is live we'll run a short load test (5-10 min) to validate p99 latency.

omar: Roger. Closing here until pool is provisioned.
